name: Sure
cost: Free to self-host (AGPLv3). Hosting costs whatever your server costs
works_with: Docker Compose; a browser, the macOS desktop app, the mobile app, API clients and AI agents
short: A personal finance app you host yourself with Docker, a community fork of the abandoned Maybe Finance project.
what: Sure is a full personal finance app that tracks cashflow, net worth and spending, with an optional AI assistant. It is a community-run fork of Maybe Finance, which stopped development and open-sourced its code. You run it on your own computer or server with Docker Compose, and there are one-click deploys for Render, PikaPods and Hostim.
who: People who want a finance dashboard where they keep the data, and who are fine running Docker. If you want a hosted app with nothing to maintain, this is not it.
needs: A secret key and a database password you generate
Optional: an SMTP server for password reset and other emails
Optional: an SSL certificate if you open it to the internet

steps.title: Generate a secret key
steps.text: Put it in `.env` as `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, and set `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` too.

steps.title: Start it
steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000 and click "create your account".

steps.title: Run it in the background
steps.text: Press Ctrl+C first, then start it detached.

try.label: From the README
try.text: After your first account, go to Settings > Self-Hosting > Onboarding and switch signups to Closed if you don't want anyone else to register.

watch: Keep your `SECRET_KEY_BASE`. It also seeds the keys that encrypt provider tokens and other sensitive data, and a new one makes that data unreadable.
Anyone can register until you set signups to Invite-only or Closed.
The Simple AI deploy uses OpenAI and asks for an OpenAI token.
Without SMTP it sends no emails. Self-hosted invitations are never emailed, so you copy the link from Settings yourself.
If you put it on the internet behind HTTPS, set `RAILS_ASSUME_SSL` to `true` in `compose.yml`.
